author: Mariana Costa
content: SystemForge transformed our clinic. The electronic medical records system they built is intuitive and reduced our administrative processing time by 40%. I recommend them without hesitation.

author: Rafael Oliveira
content: We needed a complete marketplace in 3 months. SystemForge delivered in 10 weeks with excellent product quality. What sets them apart is that they think about your business, not just the code.

author: Lucia Ferrari
content: We needed a custom SaaS platform for the Italian market. SystemForge immediately understood our requirements and delivered an excellent product on schedule.

author: Carlos Mendes
content: The logistics dashboard SystemForge built replaced 3 separate tools. Real-time visibility and reports that used to take hours are now available in one click.

author: Ana Paula Lima
content: My online store turned out exactly as I imagined — fast, polished, and easy to use both for managing inventory and for customers at checkout. Sales grew 60% in the first month.

author: Thiago Souza
content: Integrating our legacy ERP with our sales channels was a nightmare. SystemForge built a robust API that now processes 50,000 orders per day without incidents. Impeccable support.
